notes_for_editor: Two different lookouts share this name. This record is the Payette NF tower in Idaho County (6,262 ft). The Kaniksu NF Grass Mountain in Boundary County (6,205 ft; platform tower and cabin in the 1930s, L-4 tower 1936, destroyed 1955) appears on the Idaho Fire Lookouts northern-idaho page (grass-mountain-lookout-2) and firelookout.com grassmtn234; those were read and deliberately not used. Three sources agree on the 1934 cab and the 1978 destruction; little else exists. No staffing source found, so none is written. The brief county 'Idaho' is corrected to Idaho County.
